features.label: Top-up regularity
features.unit: share of weeks with a top-up

personas.name: Gig driver
personas.about: Ride-hail driver, on the phone all day. Small top-ups almost every week.

personas.name: University student
personas.about: Second-year student. New SIM since moving for university, tops up when the balance runs out.

personas.name: Office worker
personas.about: Admin staff at a firm on Jalan Sudirman. Same number for seven years.

personas.name: Market trader
personas.about: Runs a textile stall. Calls a lot, little data, balance often hits zero before market days.

personas.name: Factory newcomer
personas.about: Moved from Central Java three months ago for a factory job. Still between rented rooms.
